review:
Oktoberfest on BGaming's Bonanza engine: beer jugs and glasses pay anywhere on screen, and it's the total number of matching symbols at the end of the spin that counts. Reels refill after wins, so one spin can pay several times.

Free spins are where the multipliers live – 2x to 100x, boosting the whole sequence. It's basically Bonanza Billion in lederhosen, so pick it if you like the festival look. 15,000x max and 95.97% RTP, but the bonus is a slow burn: around once every 395 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
